hint.text:
Use gerund after:
• verb/adjective/noun + preposition
• certain verbs (enjoy, avoid, regret, consider, miss, ...)
• certain phrases (instead of, have trouble, can’t help)

Use infinitive after:
• adjectives and nouns
• certain verbs (decide, try, refuse, demand, pretend, ...)
• it + adjective and how (it’s important to.../he explained how to...)

instruction.text: Complete the newspaper article. Decide whether to use gerund or infinitive.

atoms.b:
Balancing Privacy and Security in a digital society
In recent years, governments have intensified efforts to increase national security, even if that means ((monitoring --to_monitor)) citizens’ online activities. While authorities claim that it is necessary ((to_protect --protecting)) the public from potential threats, many people feel uncomfortable with ((sacrificing --to_sacrifice)) their privacy. Civil rights organizations have started ((to_raise raising)) awareness of how surveillance measures may affect democratic freedoms.

feedback.wrong1: Das Verb to mean wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet, wenn es sich auf ein Resultat einer Handlung bezieht.
feedback.wrong4: Das Verb to start kann mit dem Gerundium oder dem Infinitiv verwendet werden.

atoms.b: Experts advise policymakers ((to_consider --considering)) long-term consequences before implementing stricter monitoring systems. Meanwhile, citizens are encouraged to stay informed by ((participating --to_participate)) in public debates and demanding transparency. At the same time, some individuals have begun ((to_question questioning)) whether mass surveillance actually leads to greater safety, instead of simply ((normalizing --to_normalize)) constant state control.

feedback.wrong3: Das Verb to begin kann mit dem Gerundium oder dem Infinitiv verwendet werden.
feedback.wrong4:
Die Phrase instead of wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.
Das Adjektiv simply kann man weggelassen und kann hier daher ignoriert werden.

instruction.text: Complete the newspaper article. Use the verbs below. Decide whether to use gerund or infinitive.

atoms.b:
Scrolling into stress?
With smartphones being used constantly, many people struggle to avoid ((checking)) their devices, even during meals or before sleeping. Psychologists have begun ((to_warn warning)) about the addictive design of many apps, which are meant to keep users engaged as long as possible.

feedback.wrong1: Das Verb to avoid wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.
feedback.wrong2: Das Verb to begin kann mit dem Gerundium oder dem Infinitiv verwendet werden.

atoms.b: Instead of ((helping)) users disconnect, many platforms seem to profit from keeping them online. Recent studies have shown that failing ((to_set)) boundaries between online and offline time can lead to anxiety and sleeping disorders.

feedback.wrong1: Die Phrase instead of wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet..
feedback.wrong2: Das Verb to fail wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

atoms.b: Some experts recommend ((creating to_create)) daily routines that include digital breaks, while others advise young people ((to_learn)) to reflect critically on their screen time. After all, protecting one’s mental health may require ((rethinking to_think)) the way we use technology altogether.

feedback.wrong1: Das Verb to recommend kann mit dem Gerundium oder dem Infinitiv verwendet werden.
feedback.wrong2: Das Verb to advise + Objekt wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.
feedback.wrong3: Das Verb to require kann mit dem Gerundium oder dem Infinitiv verwendet werden. Das Objekt bezieht sich hier auf ein Konzept, weshalb das Gerundium besser passt.
